WITH cohort AS (
  -- one row per account created from January to September 2025
  SELECT account_id, CAST(date_trunc('month', created_at) AS DATE) AS cohort_month
  FROM accounts
  WHERE created_at >= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01 00:00:00'
    AND created_at < TIMESTAMP '2025-10-01 00:00:00'
),
cohort_counts AS (
  -- one row per cohort month
  SELECT c.cohort_month, COUNT(DISTINCT c.account_id) AS cohort_size,
         COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN m.month = c.cohort_month + INTERVAL 1 MONTH THEN c.account_id END) AS kept_m1,
         COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN m.month = c.cohort_month + INTERVAL 3 MONTH THEN c.account_id END) AS kept_m3,
         COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN m.month = c.cohort_month + INTERVAL 6 MONTH THEN c.account_id END) AS kept_m6,
         SUM(CASE WHEN m.month = c.cohort_month THEN m.mrr_eur END) AS new_mrr
  FROM cohort AS c
  LEFT JOIN mrr_monthly AS m ON m.account_id = c.account_id
  GROUP BY c.cohort_month
),
month_revenue AS (
  -- one row per month: the MRR of every account on the last day of the month
  SELECT month, SUM(mrr_eur) AS revenue
  FROM mrr_monthly
  GROUP BY month
),
month_cogs AS (
  -- one row per month
  SELECT month, SUM(amount_eur) AS cogs
  FROM cogs_monthly
  GROUP BY month
),
month_media AS (
  -- one row per month: the paid media of every channel
  SELECT month, SUM(spend_eur) AS media
  FROM marketing_spend_monthly
  GROUP BY month
),
month_other AS (
  -- one row per month: the other sales and marketing costs, the shared rows included
  SELECT month, SUM(amount_eur) AS other_cost
  FROM sm_expense_monthly
  GROUP BY month
)
SELECT k.cohort_month, k.cohort_size,
       CASE WHEN k.cohort_month + INTERVAL 1 MONTH <= DATE '2025-12-01'
            THEN ROUND(100.0 * k.kept_m1 / k.cohort_size, 1) END AS ret_m1_pct,
       CASE WHEN k.cohort_month + INTERVAL 3 MONTH <= DATE '2025-12-01'
            THEN ROUND(100.0 * k.kept_m3 / k.cohort_size, 1) END AS ret_m3_pct,
       CASE WHEN k.cohort_month + INTERVAL 6 MONTH <= DATE '2025-12-01'
            THEN ROUND(100.0 * k.kept_m6 / k.cohort_size, 1) END AS ret_m6_pct,
       ROUND(k.new_mrr, 2) AS new_mrr,
       ROUND(100.0 * (r.revenue - g.cogs) / r.revenue, 1) AS gm_pct,
       ROUND((p.media + o.other_cost) / (k.new_mrr * (r.revenue - g.cogs) / r.revenue), 1) AS cac_payback_months
FROM cohort_counts AS k
JOIN month_revenue AS r ON r.month = k.cohort_month
JOIN month_cogs AS g ON g.month = k.cohort_month
JOIN month_media AS p ON p.month = k.cohort_month
JOIN month_other AS o ON o.month = k.cohort_month
ORDER BY k.cohort_month

WITH cohort AS (
  -- one row per account created from January to September 2025
  SELECT account_id, CAST(date_trunc('month', created_at) AS DATE) AS cohort_month
  FROM accounts
  WHERE created_at >= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01 00:00:00'
    AND created_at < TIMESTAMP '2025-10-01 00:00:00'
),
flags AS (
  -- one row per cohort account, with its first month's MRR and a 1 for each later month it has a row
  SELECT c.account_id, c.cohort_month,
         (SELECT m.mrr_eur FROM mrr_monthly AS m
          WHERE m.account_id = c.account_id AND m.month = c.cohort_month) AS first_mrr,
         CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM mrr_monthly AS m
                           WHERE m.account_id = c.account_id AND m.month = c.cohort_month + INTERVAL 1 MONTH) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS in_m1,
         CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM mrr_monthly AS m
                           WHERE m.account_id = c.account_id AND m.month = c.cohort_month + INTERVAL 3 MONTH) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS in_m3,
         CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM mrr_monthly AS m
                           WHERE m.account_id = c.account_id AND m.month = c.cohort_month + INTERVAL 6 MONTH) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS in_m6
  FROM cohort AS c
),
cohort_counts AS (
  -- one row per cohort month
  SELECT cohort_month, COUNT(*) AS cohort_size, SUM(in_m1) AS kept_m1, SUM(in_m3) AS kept_m3, SUM(in_m6) AS kept_m6,
         SUM(first_mrr) AS new_mrr
  FROM flags
  GROUP BY cohort_month
),
month_figures AS (
  -- one row per month: revenue, COGS and sales and marketing cost
  SELECT r.month, r.revenue,
         (SELECT SUM(g.amount_eur) FROM cogs_monthly AS g WHERE g.month = r.month) AS cogs,
         (SELECT SUM(p.spend_eur) FROM marketing_spend_monthly AS p WHERE p.month = r.month)
           + (SELECT SUM(o.amount_eur) FROM sm_expense_monthly AS o WHERE o.month = r.month) AS sm_cost
  FROM (
    -- one row per month: the MRR of every account on the last day of the month
    SELECT month, SUM(mrr_eur) AS revenue FROM mrr_monthly GROUP BY month
  ) AS r
)
SELECT k.cohort_month, k.cohort_size,
       CASE WHEN date_diff('month', k.cohort_month, DATE '2025-12-01') >= 1 THEN ROUND(100.0 * k.kept_m1 / k.cohort_size, 1) END AS ret_m1_pct,
       CASE WHEN date_diff('month', k.cohort_month, DATE '2025-12-01') >= 3 THEN ROUND(100.0 * k.kept_m3 / k.cohort_size, 1) END AS ret_m3_pct,
       CASE WHEN date_diff('month', k.cohort_month, DATE '2025-12-01') >= 6 THEN ROUND(100.0 * k.kept_m6 / k.cohort_size, 1) END AS ret_m6_pct,
       ROUND(k.new_mrr, 2) AS new_mrr,
       ROUND(100.0 * (f.revenue - f.cogs) / f.revenue, 1) AS gm_pct,
       ROUND((f.sm_cost / k.cohort_size) / ((k.new_mrr / k.cohort_size) * (f.revenue - f.cogs) / f.revenue), 1) AS cac_payback_months
FROM cohort_counts AS k
JOIN month_figures AS f ON f.month = k.cohort_month
ORDER BY k.cohort_month

  LEFT JOIN activity AS a1 ON a1.account_id = c.account_id AND a1.month_no = 1
  LEFT JOIN activity AS a3 ON a3.account_id = c.account_id AND a3.month_no = 3

WITH coh AS (
  SELECT account_id, CAST(date_trunc('month', created_at) AS DATE) AS cm
  FROM accounts
  WHERE created_at >= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01 00:00:00' AND created_at < TIMESTAMP '2025-10-01 00:00:00'
), mm AS (
  SELECT c.cm,
         COUNT(*) AS size,
         COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE r1.account_id IS NOT NULL) AS r1,
         COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE r3.account_id IS NOT NULL) AS r3,
         COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE r6.account_id IS NOT NULL) AS r6,
         COALESCE(SUM(r0.mrr_eur), 0) AS new_mrr
  FROM coh c
  LEFT JOIN mrr_monthly r0 ON r0.account_id = c.account_id AND r0.month = c.cm
  LEFT JOIN mrr_monthly r1 ON r1.account_id = c.account_id AND r1.month = CAST(c.cm + INTERVAL 1 MONTH AS DATE)
  LEFT JOIN mrr_monthly r3 ON r3.account_id = c.account_id AND r3.month = CAST(c.cm + INTERVAL 3 MONTH AS DATE)
  LEFT JOIN mrr_monthly r6 ON r6.account_id = c.account_id AND r6.month = CAST(c.cm + INTERVAL 6 MONTH AS DATE)
  GROUP BY c.cm
), rev AS (SELECT month, SUM(mrr_eur) AS revenue FROM mrr_monthly GROUP BY month),
cg AS (SELECT month, SUM(amount_eur) AS cogs FROM cogs_monthly GROUP BY month),
mk AS (SELECT month, SUM(spend_eur) AS v FROM marketing_spend_monthly GROUP BY month),
sm AS (SELECT month, SUM(amount_eur) AS v FROM sm_expense_monthly GROUP BY month)
SELECT mm.cm AS cohort_month,
       mm.size AS cohort_size,
       ROUND(100.0 * mm.r1 / mm.size, 1) AS ret_m1_pct,
       CASE WHEN CAST(mm.cm + INTERVAL 3 MONTH AS DATE) <= DATE '2025-12-01' THEN ROUND(100.0 * mm.r3 / mm.size, 1) END AS ret_m3_pct,
       CASE WHEN CAST(mm.cm + INTERVAL 6 MONTH AS DATE) <= DATE '2025-12-01' THEN ROUND(100.0 * mm.r6 / mm.size, 1) END AS ret_m6_pct,
       ROUND(mm.new_mrr, 2) AS new_mrr,
       ROUND(100.0 * (rev.revenue - cg.cogs) / rev.revenue, 1) AS gm_pct,
       ROUND(((COALESCE(mk.v, 0) + COALESCE(sm.v, 0)) / mm.size)
             / ((mm.new_mrr / mm.size) * ((rev.revenue - cg.cogs) / rev.revenue)), 1) AS cac_payback_months
FROM mm
JOIN rev ON rev.month = mm.cm
JOIN cg ON cg.month = mm.cm
LEFT JOIN mk ON mk.month = mm.cm
LEFT JOIN sm ON sm.month = mm.cm
ORDER BY mm.cm
